# Thanksgiving Hymns Column 13 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** 1QHa (Cave 1), Col. 13 | **Condition:** moderately well preserved

---

**13:1** When all the arrows of the pit fly beyond recall and are loosed beyond hope;

**13:2** when the measuring line falls upon judgment and the lot of wrath upon the forsaken,

**13:3** and the outpouring of fury upon the hidden ones, and the time of anger upon all Belial;

**13:4** and the cords of death enclose with no escape, and the torrents of Belial overflow every high bank.

**13:5** Like fire devouring every channel, consuming every green tree and dry from their banks,

**13:6** and it lashes with tongues of flame until none who drink from them remain.

**13:7** It eats into the foundations of clay and the expanse of the dry land;

**13:8** the bases of the mountains are given over to burning, and the roots of flint become torrents of pitch.

**13:9** And it devours down to the great abyss, and the torrents of Belial burst into Abaddon,

**13:10** and the creatures of the abyss cry out amid the churning of the mire.

**13:11** The earth cries out at the calamity come upon the world, and all its creatures shriek,

**13:12** and all upon it lose their senses, staggering in the great catastrophe.

**13:13** For God thunders with the roar of His strength, and His holy dwelling resounds with His glorious truth,

**13:14** and the host of heaven raises its voice, and the eternal foundations dissolve and quake,

**13:15** and the war of heaven's warriors sweeps through the world and does not turn back

**13:16** until the final consummation decreed forever, and nothing compares to it.

**13:17** I thank You, O Lord, for You have redeemed my soul from the pit,

**13:18** and from Sheol-Abaddon You have raised me up to an eternal height.

**13:19** I walk upon a limitless plain, and I know that there is hope

**13:20** for the one You have formed from dust for the eternal council.

**13:21** You have purified the perverse spirit from great transgression, to stand in the station

**13:22** with the host of the holy ones and to enter into community with the congregation of the sons of heaven.

**13:23** You have cast for a man an eternal lot with the spirits of knowledge,

**13:24** to praise Your name in a community of jubilation and to recount Your wonders before all Your works.

**13:25** And I, a creature of clay -- what have I spoken that was not previously planned,

**13:26** and what can I devise that has not been thought before? All is inscribed before You

**13:27** with the stylus of remembrance for all the appointed times of eternity,

**13:28** and for the numbered cycles of the years of the world in all their appointed seasons,

**13:29** and they are not hidden, and not one of them is lacking from before You.

**13:30** How shall a man reckon up his sin? How shall he plead concerning his iniquities?

**13:31** How shall he answer every righteous judgment? Yours, O God of knowledge, are

**13:32** all the works of righteousness and the counsel of truth. But to the sons of men belongs

**13:33** the service of iniquity and the deeds of deceit.

**13:34** You created the breath of the tongue. You know its words and established the fruit of the lips

**13:35** before they existed. You set words upon a measuring line and the utterance of breath by measure.

**13:36** You bring forth the lines according to their secrets and the breathings according to their reckoning,

**13:37** to make known Your glory and to recount Your wonders in all Your works of truth and Your righteous judgments.

---
*SOPHIA notes: Column 13 features an apocalyptic overture followed by thanksgiving and a meditation on determinism. SOPHIA adopted EMET's "torrents of Belial" (over LOGOS's "floods"). "Stylus of remembrance" preferred over LOGOS's "pen." The thanksgiving section (13:17-24) closely parallels 12:24-32. See disagreement log for 7 divergences.*
